name: GraphRareBench
description: Phenotype-driven diagnostic benchmarks usually report the rank of the reference disease, but they rarely reveal which plausible alternatives are ranked above it or what evidence a tool-using model examines before making its decision. We introduce GraphRareBench, a provenance-preserving benchmark containing 2,365 ontology-derived cases and 18,093 target-confounder pairs. Each case includes a coarsened HPO query, a fixed candidate pool, graph-defined hard confounders, and source-linked evidence records.
